_SAMPLE_USER_CACHE = {}


def sample_batch(user_train, itemnum, batch_size, maxlen):
    cache_key = (id(user_train), itemnum)
    cached = _SAMPLE_USER_CACHE.get(cache_key)
    if cached is None or cached[0] is not user_train:
        users = [
            user for user, history in user_train.items()
            if len(history) >= 2
            and len({int(i) for i in history if 1 <= int(i) <= itemnum}) < itemnum
        ]
        if not users:
            raise RuntimeError("No training users have a next-item pair and an unseen negative")
        _SAMPLE_USER_CACHE.clear()
        _SAMPLE_USER_CACHE[cache_key] = (user_train, users)
    else:
        users = cached[1]
